prior_exposure_limitation: Same-model lineage and wider project involvement cannot be erased. No prior Dr Eggman-specific ChatGPT authored verdict, GrokBot advisory, two-model reconciliation, or ranking decision was opened for this Stage A
official_legality_scope: October 14 owner gate passed with Oracle/legality verification; targeted commander and proposed-card rules checked; no fresh entire-deck legality recertification
identity: Five-mana Human Scientist's one-card end-step draw plus sequential opponent villainous choices between actual discard and eligible Construct/Robot/Vehicle entry from the controller's hand
natural_ceiling_hypothesis: Optimized Bracket 4 without new measured power score

primary_hypothesis.expected_gain: Cheap repeatable way to recycle killed/discarded big artifacts by sacrificing disposable on-board artifacts, independent of opponents' Eggman choices
primary_hypothesis.strongest_counterargument: Welder is 1/1, summoning-sick, neither Eggman-cheatable nor useful without two valid targets and graveyard fuel; Caress makes actual opponent discard costly and supports the commander-designed villainous fork

secondary_tests: 31-land seven-rock turn-five colored source and recovery stress test
Valeyard/Roaming Throne/Strionic triggers and empty-hand no-op
Scrap Mastery symmetrical recursion only if warranted
important_rules: Opponents may choose to discard with empty hands and discard nothing, preventing machine entry and avoiding actual discard triggers
Each opponent resolves a separate villainous choice sequentially after just one Eggman draw for each trigger resolution
Eggman can put only Construct, Robot or Vehicle cards from its controller's hand onto battlefield; these are not cast
Roaming Throne must select Human or Scientist to double Eggman's triggered ability and does not multiply it by naming Construct or Robot
Goblin Welder's battlefield artifact and graveyard artifact card targets must involve same player; both legal targets required to exchange
Discard payoffs require an actual card to be discarded, not a chosen discard option with empty hand
